metadata.question: Did the total water surface area within a 5 km radius of Agudo, Brazil increase between November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Agudo, Brazil (coordinates ~29.8°S, 55.3°W) - Dates: November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good temporal and spatial resolution for water detection) - Buffer: 5 km radius around Agudo 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is essential to get accurate water surface area - Water detection using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) = (B3-B8)/(B3+B8) - NDWI > 0.3 typically indicates water 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check image collection sizes for both dates - Calculate valid pixel counts after cloud masking - Compare water areas: if either date has 0 valid pixels → C2, if calculation fails → C3 - Answer A if area increased, B if decreased or stayed similar ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Agudo, Brazil location and 5 km buffer const agudoCoords = [-55.32, -29.79]; // Longitude, Latitude const agudoPoint = ee.Geometry.Point(agudoCoords); const bufferGeom = agudoPoint.buffer(5000); // 5 km radius in meters // 2. Define date ranges const date1Start = '2023-11-05'; const date1End = '2023-11-06'; const date2Start = '2023-11-21'; const date2End = '2023-11-22'; // 3. Function to mask clouds and calculate water area const getWaterArea = async (startDate, endDate) => { let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(bufferGeom) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const colSize = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found for ${startDate}: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { return { area: null, pixels: 0, error: 'No images found' }; } // Median composite to reduce noise const composite = col.median(); // Cloud masking using SCL band (Scene Classification) const cloudMask = composite.select('SCL').neq(3).and(composite.select('SCL').neq(8)).and(composite.select('SCL').neq(9)).and(composite.select('SCL').neq(10)); const masked = composite.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate NDWI for water detection: (B3 - B8) / (B3 + B8) const ndwi = masked.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water mask: NDWI > 0.3 const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.3); // Count valid water pixels const pixelCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bufferGeom, scale: 10, // Sentinel-2 native resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Calculate water area in km² const waterArea = pixelCount * 0.0001; // Each pixel is 10m x 10m = 0.01 km² return { area: waterArea, pixels: pixelCount, error: null }; }; // 4. Get water areas for both dates const result1 = await getWaterArea(date1Start, date1End); const result2 = await getWaterArea(date2Start, date2End); console.log(`Nov 5, 2023 - Water pixels: ${result1.pixels}, Area: ${result1.area?.toFixed(3)} km²`); console.log(`Nov 21, 2023 - Water pixels: ${result2.pixels}, Area: ${result2.area?.toFixed(3)} km²`); // 5. Validation and comparison if (result1.error || result2.error) { console.log('Error in data retrieval'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (result1.pixels === 0 || result2.pixels === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (result1.area === null || result2.area === null || isNaN(result1.area) || isNaN(result2.area)) { console.log('Calculation produced invalid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Final comparison const areaDiff = result2.area - result1.area; console.log(`Area difference: ${areaDiff.toFixed(4)} km²`); if (areaDiff > 0.01) { // Using small threshold to account for natural variation console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
